notes.title: Hot Fix 0.8.6.1.9
notes.content: Various visual tweaks to enhance atmosphere

notes.title: Hot Fix 0.8.6.1.8
notes.content:
Fixed a bug with Tutorial weapon missing jump attacks
 Updated Tutorial enemy visuals
 Fixed a bug with Jump behavior and control

notes.title: Hot Fix 0.8.6.1.7
notes.content:
Implemented additional fixes to prevent Boss AI from losing aggro during combat
 Adjusted Yellow Attack: Now if player mistimes the rapid parry, they will be punished for the full attack sequence instead of just the missed ones
 Fixed a bug that affects player’s movement speed while holding Block button
 Fixed a bug where player might get soft locked if not picking up the Tutorial Weapon

notes.title: Hot Fix 0.8.6.1.6
notes.content:
Fixed a bug where Currency display does not get refreshed after fusing shards
 Slight buff to Sentinel’s aggression level
 Improved Shader Compilation speed
 Fixed a bug where Winged Sentry loses Hitbox when hit by shotgun
 Fixed a bug where Death Screen could be locked if player pressed ESC or Cancel
 If player loses all forms and quit to Menu screen, clicking Continue will send them back to Netherrealm

notes.title: Hot Fix 0.8.6.1.5
notes.content:
Implemented a possible fix for Gamepad Joystick walk issue that occurs on some Controllers
 Fixed a bug where Brigand’s Shotgun skill could break AI hitbox

notes.title: Hot Fix 0.8.6.1.4
notes.content:
Fixed a bug where starting Sentry boss fight does not replenish heals
 Fixed a bug with Woodsman boss giving incorrect currency reward
 Fixed a bug where Instruction note could get stuck on the screen if the player gets attacked
 Stat adjustment to Brigand: lower base stats but faster swing speed
 Implemented a possible fix for Boss Health bar overlapping another in the Interrogation Room
 Implemented a possible fix for Boss AI losing aggro when rapidly get hit by player
 Added Tutorial prompt for swapping item between Loot Bag and Quick Items
 Added Green General NPC before Princess fight to provide some guidance

notes.title: Hot Fix 0.8.6.1.3
notes.content:
Added on-screen message to notify players their heals get replenished when starting a Boss fight
 Added on-screen message for insufficient stamina
 Buffed Sewer Dweller boss: faster attacks and more aggressive
 Buffed Winged Sentry boss: faster attacks, higher damage
 Implemented a possible fix for Boss AI losing aggro in the Interrogation room
 Fixed a bug with the Monk’s Warp Strike ability, now correctly evade through any attack
 Fixed a bug where player’s Weapon Skill could potentially break AI’s hit box when AI is in the middle of dodging
 Added tutorial message explaining when collected items get moved to Storage
 Implemented another possible fix for Skill Tree confirmation box bug

notes.title: Hot Fix 0.8.6.1.2
notes.content:
Added Boss Rush timer stats and ability to select which Form to fight the boss in the Interrogation room
 Added End of Demo message
 Fixed a duplicate loot ID issue that prevents some loot from appearing
 Fixed a bug where the first Tutorial Soul Shard could be duplicated if player spams pick up
 Fixed Sentinel’s Triple Thrust attack to no longer miss if the player sticks too close
 Fixed several collision bugs in Annam where player could fall through the floor or get stuck

notes.title: Hot Fix 0.8.6.1.1
notes.content:
Fixed a visual bug when loading Tutorial map
 Improved Annam map optimization and reduced some stuttering in boss arena
 Fixed Duelist’s Shard, now correctly increasing Parry Damage
 Fixed a bug where the Soul Watcher cannot be interacted in the Netherrealm

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.8.6.1
notes.content:
Added on-screen button prompts for Yin/Yang attack. This can be turned off in the Options menu.
 Updated Tutorial flow to better explain Reincarnation mechanics
 Fixed a bug with Soul Shard fusion calculation
 Fixed a bug where using Weapon Art while boss was on the ground breaks their hitbox
 Fixed a bug where mouse cursor popped up during Cinematic cutscene
 Tuned some attack hitboxes to better hit the player
 Fixed a bug where some bosses spawn Soul Limbo on death
 Fixed a bug where turrets permanently lose aggro when player goes outside range then return
 Changed Swim Up/Down controls to RB and LB
 Increased the speed of loot drop so player no longer have to wait for dead body to dissolve
 Fixed a bug where player could repeatedly trigger door opening animation
 Fixed a visual bug where character is stuck with an overlay VFX effect
 Implemented a possible fix for when the player suddenly unable to turn after attacking
 Implemented a possible fix for Confirmation box getting stuck on screen when unlocking new skill
 Slightly raised LockOn Camera to give a better view of the opponent
 Reduced the Woodsman’s fire glow
 Slightly longer Red/Blue/Yellow flash when enemies perform an unblockable attack
 Various other minor visual and UI bug fixes

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.8.6.0
notes.content:
Doubled the size of Annam with new bosses and minibosses

Added Bosh Rush system

Reworked the entire progression system, now featuring a new Soul Shard fusion system

Reworked the entire Skill Tree for each class and introduced Talents

Reworked every weapon to have more unique ability and move set

Reworked the Reincarnation system. Dying in the mortal realm will lose that Revenant form.

Reworked the checkpoint system. Checkpoint no longer respawns enemies or recharges heals. Replaced by the Soul Limbo mechanic.

Various other bug fixes and improvements

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.8.5.9.7
notes.content:
New Miniboss: The Feathered Princess! The new boss replaced the old Archer boss
 Fixed a bug where pressing (A) in Title Menu does not work
 Player’s revival now starts at 50% max health
 Made adjustments to minibosses’ health and damage to make them more dangerous
 Reduced player’s base Stamina damage, but increases Parry damage for better risk/reward
 Other visual enhancements and minor bug fixes

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.8.5.9.6
notes.content:
Fixed a bug where player gets stuck near Marketplace grave.
 Fixed Camera Shake setting bug
 Allowed Motion Blur to be disabled.
 Fixed ESC bug in Options menu
 Added option to adjust camera smoothing speed
 Added option to cap frame rate at 90 and 120
 Fixed a bug where clicking with mouse in Confirmation Box always results in Yes
 Tab icons are now clickable by mouse
 Small adjustment to enemy aggression and stats in Tutorial level
 Other visual enhancement and minor bug fixes

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.8.5.9.5
notes.content:
Fixed a bug where player gets stuck during Tutorial outro
 Fixed a bug where player gets stuck in Frog’s arena
 Visual improvements to Annam capital map
 Added tutorial message for Skill point

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.8.5.9.4
notes.content:
Implemented new stylized art style for testing & feedback
 Added new cinematic sequences and NPCs for Tutorial level
 Other minor bug fixes

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.8.5.9.3
notes.content:
Added Sentinel boss intro cinematic
 Fixed Resolution setting bug
 Fixed a bug when player chooses Forfeit immediately after Respawn
 Fixed UI bug in the Title menu that resets game progress
 Prevented player from getting hit during activation animation (Grave, Doors, Statue)

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.8.5.9.2
notes.content:
Sage NPC now offers respecs for skills and stats
 Bug fixes and level collision improvements
 Added small pictures for Grave locations
 Changed the Capital level back to daylight lighting

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.8.5.9.1
notes.content:
Fixed several bugs that cause crash (Shader compilation, Frozen attack, Revenant switch)
 Slight improvement to overall performance
 Fixed a bug with Graphics options Shadow settings
 Updated level lighting

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.8.5.9
notes.content:
Summary of changes in this version:

 Revamped the entire progression system
 Implemented Reincarnation system as the new core game loop
 Introduced Skill Trees for each Revenant class
 Reworked the entire Capital map (improved Minibosses, new lighting and visuals)
 Improved all Weapon Arts to now deal elemental damages
 Improved various animations and SFX
 Various bug fixes and performance improvements

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.8.5.8
notes.content:
Summary of changes in this version:

 Revenants now take human forms in the Mortal Realm!
 Visual improvements to 3 mini-bosses in the first level
 Other minor bug fixes and optimizations

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.8.5.7
notes.content:
Summary of changes in this version:

 Added an Assist Mode that allows players to modify combat difficulty
 Updated the starting Weapon Arts for each Revenant class
 Major improvements to the 2nd Boss Fight
 Increased the base efficiency of healing and adjusted enemy's base damage
 Various other bug fixes and enhancements


We continue to make update to the build based on playtesters' feedback. 
Join our Discord to become a closed beta tester and share your thoughts.
